reference_sql:
WITH by_country AS (SELECT s.country_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' GROUP BY s.country_code),
total AS (SELECT SUM(n_orders) AS n_all FROM by_country)
SELECT b.country_code, b.n_orders, ROUND(b.n_orders / t.n_all, 4) AS share_of_orders
FROM by_country b
CROSS JOIN total t

solver.query:
SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_type = 'web' THEN 'NL' ELSE s.country_code END AS country_code,
       COUNT(*) AS n_orders,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 4) AS share_of_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1
